title: Paul McCartney live: FleetCenter, Boston | 2002
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the FleetCenter in Boston, Massachusetts, USA, on 30 September 2002.

It was the 33rd date of the Driving World Tour, which lasted for 58 dates across four countries between April and November 2002, and the first of two consecutive nights in Boston.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

The Driving World Tour had previously called at the FleetCenter on 19 April 2002. McCartney performed there again during the US Tour on 26 and 27 September 2005.
